_note: Held-out public fake-police (ニセ警察) cases published on or after T = 2026-04-01, transcribed from docs/research.md R2 (table rows 1-10 and 15, the narrative-rich ones). Only the facts the research recorded are stated as facts; everything the sim has to add to run a counter replay is listed in `assumptions`. No dialogue from the sources is reproduced. The research found ~10-11 such cases, not the 20 targeted: R2b (Tokyo, Saitama, Osaka, Kanagawa bulletins) has not been done, so this file has to be extended before the set is complete.
